messages:
maya: Heads up — customer (acct: acme-corp) seeing streaming responses cut off after an auth refresh. Client reconnects immediately and gets partial last chunk. Started after they enabled S3 prewarm proxy in front of ALB. Anyone seen interplay between ALB idle and Cloudflare worker keepalive?

dan: Ugh. Do we have a request id/trace? INC-12345?

maya: INC-12345 + logs attached in ticket. root id=aa3f9. Happened ~15:23 UTC. Repro is flaky but 1/10 hits.

sophie: Quick Q — is the client using SSE or chunked Transfer-Encoding?

maya: SSE (text/event-stream). Client is a web app with reconnect logic. Auth token rotates TTL=60s. When token refresh happens while stream idle, they do a restart -> edge proxy path apparently returns EOF without final event.

support-bot: @here New support escalation INC-12345 assigned to @sophie

dan: Can you capture a curl reproduction? Try:
```
curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?session=..." 
```

maya: I ran curl with --no-buffer. Repro steps in ticket:
1) establish SSE
2) wait 70s (let token rotate)
3) trigger auth refresh (client re-auths and reconnects)
Result: client reconnects, but server's last chunk is missing on the first connection. Second connection resumes fine.

sophie: That sounds like a half-close where ALB or NLB closes the TCP socket after idle probe and the proxy chain doesn't flush trailing buffered bytes. Which LB in front?

maya: ALB -> Cloudflare -> worker -> nginx origin (k8s svc -> envoy sidecar -> app). Complex chain.

dan: Probable places to look: ALB idle timeout (default 60s), Cloudflare tunneling (600s keepalive), nginx gzip buffering, envoy egress/ingress windowing.

sophie: Check nginx config for proxy_buffering on SSE endpoints. If gzip + proxy_buffering on, nginx may aggregate small chunks and only flush on buffer full or on connection close.

maya: Current nginx snippet from customer:
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_set_header Connection '';
  proxy_buffering on;
  gzip on;
}
```

sophie: There's the issue — proxy_buffering on + gzip can coalesce chunks. Recommend proxy_buffering off for SSE and gzip off for that route.

dan: Also check ALB idle timeout — if client idle >60s and ALB half-closes, intermediary (Cloudflare worker) might do a TCP keepalive handshake that leaves buffered bytes in kernel TCP send queue; app sees FIN and stops writing, losing trailing chunk.

maya: To reproduce locally I did a tcpdump on origin while running curl. Observed FIN sent from ALB before final SSE: the last chunk bytes are still in kernel buffer and never transmitted due to application close.

sophie: Good find. Short-term mitigations:
- Recommend client heartbeat every 15s (send comment events).
- Set nginx proxy_buffering off for SSE.
- Set ALB idle timeout >= 300s if long-lived idle streams expected OR send periodic keepalive at edge.

dan: Long-term: add explicit flush at app when doing auth-refresh-induced reconnect, and add retry logic to request final chunk on reconnect if we detect partial last-event.

maya: I pushed a small patch to app (
```
res.on('close', () => {
  // attempt to flush kqueue
})
```
) but kernel-level behavior still lost depending on LB timing.

support-bot: Added note to INC-12345: escalated to eng-runtime for kernel-level tracing.

ops-bot: tagging @eng-runtime please triage; possible bug in envoy http1->http2 proxying with half-close.

sophie: Also saw similar in-house with Envoy h2->http1 where window updates cause mid-stream truncation. Configs to try: `session_buffering` off, `use_remote_address` true, and `keepalive_timeout` higher.

maya: Customer agreed to apply nginx change and enable client heartbeat. They will test today and report. I'll attach tcpdump and curl trace to ticket.

dan: If they can provide pcap showing last chunk bytes present on origin before FIN, we can prove it's LB half-close vs app flush.

maya: They provided pcap. Confirmed bytes present before FIN. Uploading to ticket.

sophie: Ok we'll recommend merging config change + document best practices in support KB: SSE endpoints must disable proxy_buffering and set matching idle timeouts across chain.

maya: Thanks — I'll schedule an oncall follow-up if they still see repro after config change. :thumbsup:

dan: Filed KB draft: KB-STREAM-002 (SSE & Proxies) with example nginx/ALB/Cloudflare settings.

maya: Closing loop here when they confirm. Last update in ticket at 17:58 UTC.
